messages:
ravi p: Heads up: publish pipeline failed on release/v1.13. regen-check shows a removed changelog line for the sample app, but the commit that added it is in the branch.

ci-bot: GH Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: line removed: 'Added: Sample app - auth retry (via sampleapp)'`

elaine z: odd. I just ran `yarn typegen && git status --porcelain` and my local CHANGELOG still contains that line. Which step removed it in CI?

typegen-bot: typegen v2.4.1 · Generated files changed: CHANGELOG.md; ordering: contributors sorted alphabetically

tom c: we shipped the 'contributors-sort' change last week to make typegen deterministic. It reorders lines like "— alice (via sampleapp)". The changelog-normalize hook strips parenthetical notes to unify contributor mentions. Combined they made the line identical to an existing line earlier in the file, so normalize deduped it.

ravi p: reproducible locally:
```
$ git checkout release/v1.13
$ yarn typegen
# CHANGELOG now has two similar lines
$ ./scripts/changelog-normalize
# normalize removes the example's "(via sampleapp)" and the duplicate line is collapsed
```
Result: one fewer 'Added' bullet -> semver-detector reports no minor bump -> publish gate refuses.

elaine z: hmm semver-detector assumes de-duplicated lines mean no user-visible change. But this is a tooling-induced dedupe, not a real loss. We need to treat dedupe-by-normalize as a change.

tom c: proposed fixes: (A) make normalize preserve parentheticals for lines matching `Sample app` or `Example`, (B) make semver-detector detect when normalize changed content and mark as change, (C) add a regendiff CI guard that runs typegen+normalize locally and in a container and diffs results to prevent surprises.

ravi p: short-term unblock: we can add an explicit changelog line with a unique suffix ` (preserve)` to force the bump, then revert after hook fix. It's ugly but fast.

elaine z: I'll own the proper fix. Opening PR #1482 to update changelog-normalize to only strip parentheticals for contributor-only lines, not for sample/example bullets. Adding unit test.

release-dog: created issue #1483: "normalize dedupe removes sample app changelog bullets causing semver misdetect" (assigned to elaine z)

typegen-bot: Created PR #1480: "regendiff-guard CI job" (contains tools/regendiff-guard.sh)

tom c: nice. also adding a flag to semver-detector: `--treat-normalize-diff-as-change` so we don't have to rely on hacky suffixes in the future. I'll open a tiny change in semver-detector repo and wire the flag in publish-typegen job.

elaine z: PR #1482 ready for review, includes test and changelog fixture. I'll coordinate with tom to land semver change in same release window.

ravi p: temporary patch pushed: `docs/CHANGELOG.md` add line `Added: Sample app - auth retry (via sampleapp) (preserve)` along with a short commit note and rebased. CI re-run queued.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by ravi p: publish-typegen · queued

elaine z: once both fixes land (normalize + semver flag), we should remove the preserve suffix and go back to clean changelog. Leaving a comment in the release board.

ravi p: thanks team. small follow-ups: update onboarding sampleapp template to avoid relying on fragile parentheticals, and add a note in the DX docs about how changelog-normalize works.

tom c: agree. I'll add a short blurb in docs/devex/release-notes.md. :ok_hand:
